about: The one Ollama release Perennos Tempo may fetch for itself when a computer has no Ollama. Each entry is a file from the official Ollama release, with the SHA-256 and size copied from the release's own sha256sum.txt (fetched 2026-11-06). Tempo checks the SHA-256 before it unpacks anything, and a file that does not match is refused. The Windows x86_64 entry is the same one the public Perennos Tempo Python edition ships. To move to a newer Ollama, change the version, the base URL and every entry together.
